verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's own feature page claims live shipping rates from leading carriers and options to print labels at home. Its shipping docs discuss shipping-label costs and carrier adjustments, which implies labels are bought through the platform. Shipment tracking is never mentioned, and the depth of checkout rate display and label purchase is thin marketing-level evidence. missing for 10: documented shipment tracking from the platform, detailed docs on live carrier rates at checkout (which carriers, configuration), explicit label purchase workflow, independent/hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, checkout shows live carrier rates and I can buy labels and track shipments from the platform

citations.quote: Save time with automated tax calculations, live shipping rates from leading carriers, options to print labels at home
Carriers verify shipment information during the delivery process and compare the cost paid for the shipping label to the actual cost to ship the package.
If the amount paid for the label is incorrect, it can result in an adjustment.
